name: Goldkine | 0.6g x 5 Infused Prerolls | Breakup Text
description:
Breakup Text is a limited-edition live resin infused 5-pack designed for moments of indulgence without expectations. 

Created as an Anti-Valentine’s release, this blend offers a refined alternative to the traditional season, focusing on flavor, quality, and experience. Breakup Text delivers a rich flavor profile inspired by the classic confection of Chocolate Covered Stawberry. Bright notes of ripe strawberry are balanced by smooth, creamy chocolate undertones, creating a decadent and satisfying finish. The aroma and flavor unfold gradually, offering a balanced experience from the first puff to the last. Whether enjoyed as a solo ritual or shared with friends, 

Breakup Text is made for those who appreciate elevated flavor and thoughtful craftsmanship. Available for a limited time, this special release delivers a bold, indulgent experience that stands apart from the ordinary.
